name: Splendor & Misery
source:
Opening in the twilight of the Saku-Takin colonial project, S&M explores its seemingly inevitable collapse through a series of intertwining perspectives, covering just shy of a decade of chaos as the storm of shifting political forces finally breaks the back of the long-fragile region. The wind carries whispers of revolution and independence; an unseen clock approaches midnight, though no one is sure just when it shall reach it. The peace of the last decade satisfied most for a time, though the crisis on Akitik Street a few short years ago destroyed the colony's economy. The desperate times since have fueled countless competing ideologies and movements, some of which are already making moves toward action, while others elsewhere have toppled governments. The fuses have been lit,  and the colony stands as a powder keg in the center of it all. It's anyone's guess as to who will eventually be able to guide Sakutakinaks out of its collapse and back onto the international stage, assuming the great powers of the Old Worlds don't kick off another conflict in the meantime.

Amidst such chaos and with so much on the line, how does one ultimately decide with whom their allegiances lie?

[From [url=https://projectulysses.itch.io/splendor-and-misery]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事从萨库塔金殖民计划的末期讲起。《Splendor & Misery》借数条相互交织的视角，描绘了这项计划看似无可避免的崩溃。将近十年的动荡中，政治势力此消彼长，终于压垮了这片早已摇摇欲坠的土地。风里有关于革命与独立的低语。看不见的时钟正走向午夜，谁也说不出何时会敲响。过去十年的和平曾一度让多数人满意，可几年前的阿基提克街危机摧毁了殖民地的经济。此后的绝境催生出无数相互竞争的思潮与运动，有些已着手行动，同类的运动甚至已在别处推翻了政府。引线已经点燃，殖民地就像火药桶，正处于这一切的中心。倘若旧世界的列强没有先挑起另一场冲突，最终会是谁带领萨库塔基纳克斯走出崩溃、重返国际舞台？谁也说不准。

身处这样的混乱，要紧的东西又如此之多，一个人究竟该如何决定自己效忠于谁？

（来源：[url=https://projectulysses.itch.io/splendor-and-misery]itch.io[/url]）
